description.value: The Port Hardy Museum, operated by the Port Hardy Heritage Society, is a community museum housing permanent exhibits of First Nations artifacts—including pieces over 8,000 years old—alongside settlers' effects, fossils, geology, and local industry displays. Rotating temporary exhibits and videos complement the permanent collection. The gift shop features locally produced native art including silver jewelry and carvings, offering a tangible connection to the region's Indigenous heritage.
